title: rhododendron viscosum
intro: Rhododendron viscosum, commonly known as Sticky Clam Rhododendron or Swamp Azalea, is a flowering plant species native to eastern North America. It has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, improving cardiovascular health, and exhibiting antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Rhododendron viscosum include its use as an anti-inflammatory agent, which may help to alleviate pain and reduce swelling. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
